name: Jig
story: A jig is three things: the workshop piece that holds and guides your tools so the work comes out the same every time (the harness); a lively dance in rounds; and JIG, a Joint Inference Graph. Only the last two are drawn: Jig is a small topology that dances.
colorRule: Every cell carries one of the grid's Meaning tokens (packages/core/src/grid/grid.ts), as a letter: the session's style table draws the logo, the indicators and the topology with one mapping. Colour means a run's state only.

d.inTheLogo: the idle mark in the footer

b.inTheLogo: a glance or a flicker; its disc grows too, so it shows where bold is not brighter

f.inTheLogo: a failed check, its snapped edge

p.inTheLogo: passed, with ✓ where a glyph fits
